oracle_policy: Each adversarial case maps one-to-one to the fixed outcome group. Expected IDs, paths, grants, source, timestamps, branch, coverage, denied markers and local-only boundaries are independently pinned in the oracle and planning packet; candidate output never creates or changes an assertion.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Query a new empty owned graph and then request a scope identifier that is not one of the authored synthetic personas.
cases.setup: Create a unique empty graph without seeding. Submit an unknown scope value; inspect only the generic response and do not enumerate valid personas.
pinned_assertions: cold graph has zero role-scoped paths
cold graph says empty/unknown and makes no availability claim
unknown scope receives a generic denial
denial reveals no valid-scope list, path count, path, or source details
no role or source identifier is invented
cases.failure_detected: Warm or default data invents paths, missing data is presented as safe/available, or invalid-scope handling discloses authorized scopes or graph contents.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Select each of the three synthetic scopes for the same hypothetical INC-312 facilities outage and inspect exact ordered paths and grant/source/time/branch provenance.
cases.setup: At 2026-10-15T06:30:00Z on BR-FPU-OUTAGE-DRILL, query dock, linen, and coordinator scopes in that order against the pinned event and source.
pinned_assertions: dock scope returns exactly INC-312 → EQ-FPU-7 → EQ-DOCK-CHARGER-2 → SVC-DOCK-TRANSFER → DEPT-RECEIVING-DOCK → ROLE-DOCK-FACILITIES
dock path trace contains only GRANT-DOCK-01
linen scope returns exactly INC-312 → EQ-FPU-7 → EQ-LINEN-CONVEYOR-7 → SVC-LINEN-TRANSFER → DEPT-LINEN-LOGISTICS → ROLE-LINEN-DUTY
linen path trace contains only GRANT-LINEN-01
coordinator returns both exact paths in dock-then-linen order
coordinator trace contains GRANT-OPS-DOCK-01 then GRANT-OPS-LINEN-01
all three outcomes are labeled hypothetical
each trace pins EVT-FPU-OUTAGE-HYP-01, SRC-TABLETOP-FPU-7, 06:15Z event, BR-FPU-OUTAGE-DRILL, and 06:30Z as-of
no scope returns an additional path
cases.failure_detected: A path or grant is missing/extra/reordered, provenance is wrong, hypothetical data is presented as observed, or an out-of-scope path is returned.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Remove exactly GRANT-DOCK-01, query all three scopes, then restore by reseeding and try a disconnected lexical decoy.
cases.setup: Use the unique verifier-owned graph. Change only the dock grant edge, preserve the separate coordinator grant edges, and include DOC-FPU-LEXICAL-DECOY-01 without a graph grant/path edge.
pinned_assertions: removing GRANT-DOCK-01 leaves dock scope with no matching path and outside scope unknown
linen scope retains its exact single path
coordinator retains both exact paths through its separate grants
reseed restores the exact dock path
the disconnected lexical decoy cannot restore a graph path
the grant removal does not mutate the event, source, branch, or other scope grants
cases.failure_detected: Scope is cosmetic post-filtering, grant removal has collateral effects, coordinator access depends on the removed grant, or lexical text recreates an absent graph edge.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Compare the fixed mainline and BR-FPU-OUTAGE-DRILL at the same as-of time, query BR-OTHER-UNKNOWN, and verify branch isolation.
cases.setup: Read mainline first, then the named hypothetical branch and a separate unknown branch on the same owned graph; reread mainline and the named branch afterward.
pinned_assertions: mainline has zero impact paths at 2026-10-15T06:30:00Z
BR-FPU-OUTAGE-DRILL returns only the two pinned scoped paths and is labeled hypothetical
BR-OTHER-UNKNOWN returns no paths
querying another branch does not change mainline or BR-FPU-OUTAGE-DRILL
cases.failure_detected: Hypothetical assumptions bleed into mainline, unrelated branch state is inherited, or branch evaluation mutates another branch.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Inspect each answer's access trace and try to interpret a scope-limited result as a global count or complete hospital view.
cases.setup: For each selected synthetic persona, compare trace fields to its explicit graph grant, returned path, source/event provenance, branch and query time; request no global aggregate.
pinned_assertions: each answer trace names the selected scope and only its explicit grant edge IDs
trace contains exactly that scope's returned path or paths
trace contains SRC-TABLETOP-FPU-7 and EVT-FPU-OUTAGE-HYP-01
trace distinguishes event time 06:15Z from as-of time 06:30Z and identifies the branch
coverage is selected_scope_only and outside_scope is unknown
source facts, graph inference, and missing/out-of-scope evidence remain distinct without a completeness claim
cases.failure_detected: Trace omits or misattributes a grant/provenance field, conflates event and query times, or implies global completeness from one selected scope.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Inject the fixed restricted source/title/body/path markers without grants and compare each selected scope's serialized API/graph/browser result before and after.
cases.setup: Record all visible role-scope results; add the denied SRC-RESTRICTED-FPU-77 fixture and its distinctive path only to the verifier-owned graph; repeat every selected-scope request and compare semantic results and visible output.
pinned_assertions: all visible selected-scope results are semantically unchanged before and after injection
no distinctive denied ID, title, body, or path marker is disclosed
no hidden source/path count or source existence is disclosed
no dependent paraphrase derived from the denied body or path is disclosed
denied fixture markers are test-only tripwires and never expected response content
cases.failure_detected: Direct content, path/count/existence side channel, or a dependent paraphrase changes a selected-scope response when an ungranted source is added.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Seed the scoped fixture twice, reconnect with a fresh database client, and compare ordered paths and complete traces.
cases.setup: Use a unique task-owned graph name incorporating WORKSHOP_LANE. Capture all three scopes, reseed the same bundle, capture again, close the client, reconnect, and capture again.
pinned_assertions: second seed creates zero duplicate nodes
second seed creates zero duplicate relationships
fresh-client reconnect preserves ordered scope paths
fresh-client reconnect preserves complete grant/source/event/branch/time traces
grant-removal counterfactual changes only the exact pinned scope outcomes
cases.failure_detected: Shared warm state hides duplicate ingestion, reconnect drops provenance or changes path order, or a scoped mutation leaks into unrelated scope results.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Switch scopes on desktop and mobile and compare each visible path/trace to the API while checking identity, clinical and external-action boundaries.
cases.setup: Exercise all three synthetic personas plus generic unknown scope on both responsive browser widths and the API; inspect outbound effects and local action behavior.
pinned_assertions: desktop displays the exact selected-scope API paths and traces
mobile displays the same exact selected-scope API paths and traces
unknown scope denial is generic and does not enumerate available personas
selector is visibly a synthetic persona, not real identity or authentication
no handover action, source mutation, ticket, message, call, or other external write is performed
no clinical inference or clinical action is produced
hypothetical branch and outside-scope unknown semantics remain visible
browser and API never disclose the fixed denied-source tripwires
cases.failure_detected: Responsive UI disagrees with graph/API, the selector is misrepresented as identity/security, or any prohibited clinical or external behavior appears.
